all_posts.cooked:
I have got the same problem in the exam but i have solved it in the exam.

When you create a symbolic link incorrectly and then run the synchronization evaluation (synchro eval), the system will save that incorrect link. To correct this, you need to follow this step:

step1 . you have to remove the soft link by running the code on terminal directly (rm workplace/ …/ …) and then run synchro eval again, if you did write the symbolic link correctly in the script.sh this time then it gonna recreate it.

your code (ln -s workspace/scripts/deploy.sh workspace/logs/deploy_log) is correct but the problem is that you did not remove the wrong symbolic link you have created in statrting.
